title: The Digital Canvas Flood Fill
statement:
An image is represented by an R x C integer grid where image[i][j] represents the pixel color. You are given starting pixel coordinates (SR, SC) and a target NewColor.

Perform a flood fill: replace the starting pixel's color and all 4-directionally adjacent pixels sharing the same initial color with NewColor. Print the final modified image.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers R and C.
Next R lines: C space-separated integers.
Last line: Three integers SR, SC, and NewColor (0-based coordinates).
outputFormat: Print the modified R x C grid.

sampleCases.explanation: All connected 1s connected to (1,1) are changed to 2.
